input.summary: Add vendor renewal reminder and cap renewal price increases at the lesser of CPI and 3%.
input.comment: [Playbook] The 30-day opt-out and one-year renewal terms work for us, but we need a 60-day renewal reminder from TrueLink and a cap on renewal pricing, so we added an uplift limit of the lesser of CPI and 3%. If a hard cap is difficult, we can accept 5% as a fallback.

ops.oldText: written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year.
ops.newText: written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year. TrueLink shall notify Client in writing of each upcoming renewal no later than sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term. Fees for any renewal term shall not exceed the fees in effect during the immediately preceding term increased by the lesser of (i) the percentage increase in the U.S. Consumer Price Index over the preceding twelve (12) months and (ii) three percent (3%).
